purpose: Compare the absolute magnitudes of all three repair outcomes within each treatment on a common percentage scale. Preserve all repeat values and sample SD. This is a multiple-series comparison, rather than three unrelated single-outcome panels.
mechanism: compact repeated component groups on common absolute scale
expected_benefit: Five compact blocks retain three separate open summaries with visible inner gaps and common numeric baseline; the series key matches open bar outlines.
observed_tradeoff: Very small sample-SD intervals in the low outcomes approach the marker diameter at the common absolute scale; their numerical endpoints are retained and high-outcome intervals remain definite.
record_timing: Purpose, roles, actual burden and concrete geometry were planned in create-intent.json, initial spec.json and agent working notes before first rendering; this durable summary was consolidated after bounded image review.
